preflight.goal_source: v3 qualified no-rod goal joint state, within 6 mm task tolerance
preflight.floor_choice: z=0 unless base sphere touches/penetrates; then 1 mm below its lowest surface

rod.motion: constant-speed reflected motion; body pose updated each capture

raised_start.method: the one warmed, wrist-constrained loop planner solves from the camera-front seed to world +0.20 m Z with the same tool orientation; the solved state is used directly as loop start and that solve is not executed as experiment motion

observation_pose_rule: exact clip(segment_start_q + held_velocity * elapsed, position_limits) at n/30 seconds, including joint stops
growth: each side +/- X/Y expands 0.20*age; full dimensions +2*0.20*age; drop after 1 s

summary.controller: cuRobo MPC tuned, held joint velocity during computation

wrist_3_limit.method: load existing YAML into cuRobo RobotCfg, modify the in-memory JointLimits.position tensor before MotionPlannerCfg.create; IK, TrajOpt, and PRM receive the same RobotCfg

validity_rule: A must collide with rod to validate rod placement; floor contact also fails each run but cannot establish rod-scene validity
perception_growth_clock: 30 Hz observation timestamps; reuse most recent observation and fit between frames
unpublished_debug_note: Initial incomplete interpolation attempt stopped and kept only under /tmp. Formal 75 runs use exact clipped observation poses; frozen controller settings unchanged.
